My primary program is Duolingo which I then supplement with Memrise.

Even though they are outdated and meant for diplomacy stuff, the FSI ( Foreign Service Institute) stuff is really good for getting the basics down FSI Language Courses. Also, Lang8 lets you write entries in your target language to natives and they'll correct your grammar. Though, I also really like Memrise and Duolingo, Both of them gamify the process of learning a languages so you get motivated to do a little work everyday. Really just find the mix that works for you the best and you'll be great!

FSI is an amazing amount of information for free. If your target langauge has a full basic course then you should be in great shape. The FSI course I have used covers so much information and gets you speaking useful stuff very quickly.
